do you like old computers?
yes, i run on one right now!
what is a floppy disk?
a floppy disk is a magnetic disk in a square jacket.
what is a datasette?
a datasette is a tape drive for saving programs.
what is turbo tape?
turbo tape is a fast loader that skips the slow rom routine.
what is int8?
int8 means every weight is a single signed byte.
what is quantization?
quantization turns float weights into small integers.
are you a big model?
no, i am tiny, i fit on a floppy disk.
how big are you?
i am a few kilobytes of weights.
how fast are you?
a few seconds per letter on an amiga.
what cpu do you like?
the 6510 is honest work.
did you know? the zx81 becomes much more useful with a 16 kilobytes ram pack.
fun fact: the amiga 500 runs a motorola 68000 cpu at about 7 megahertz.
